name: auto-photo-enhance
description: Root launcher for the Auto-photo-enhance web UI - runs webapp/server and webapp/client together. The CLI pipeline (auto_enhance_arw_to_jpg.bat, scripts/*.ps1) has no Node dependency and isn't affected by this file.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix webapp/server && npm install --prefix webapp/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix webapp/server" "npm run dev --prefix webapp/client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix webapp/server && npm test --prefix webapp/client
